---
title: "Brain Data"
author: "Oliver Pusch-Silburn"
---
Calculating regionally elevated genes in the forebrain in pigs, mice and humans. The data I'm using can be found [here](https://www.proteinatlas.org/humanproteome/brain)
```{r}
library(styler)

human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(paste("humans have ", human, " elevated genes in the forebrain"))
print(paste("pigs have ", pig, " elevated genes in the forebrain"))
print(paste("mice have ", mouse, " elevated genes in the forebrain"))
```
Humans have the most regionally elevated genes in the forebrain.
